hello.speaker: guide
hello.text: Ah, {player}. A {race} {class}, if I am not mistaken. Welcome to the test room.

task.speaker: guide
task.text: There are rats behind that locked door. Be a dear and remove them.

choices.text: What is in it for me?

bonus.speaker: guide
bonus.text: Persuasive! Take this for your trouble.

no_bonus.speaker: guide
no_bonus.text: The satisfaction of a job well done, naturally.

key.speaker: guide
key.text: I had one once. You will have to pick the lock or put your shoulder to it.

again.speaker: guide
again.text: The rats will not remove themselves.

done.speaker: guide
done.text: Nothing more for you here. Go and build a real campaign.
